_note: What you see: Reporting wrongdoing without a name, coming back with a report code
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Een misstand melden zonder naam, terugkomen met een meldcode
Ziet u iets binnen de gemeente dat niet: Do you see something within the municipality that is not right, such as fraud or misuse of money? Report it here. You do not have to say who you are.
Wat wilt u melden?: What do you want to report?
Vertel wat er gebeurt of gebeurd is. Noe: Tell us what is happening or has happened. Do not name names unless you need to.
Wij halen de gegevens over de maker uit: We remove the details about the creator from photos and documents.
Wilt u dat wij weten wie u bent? (niet v: Do you want us to know who you are? (optional)
Uw gegevens bewaren wij apart van de mel: We keep your details separate from the report. Only the municipality's confidential adviser can see them, with a reason that is recorded.
Kom terug met uw meldcode. U leest dan h: Come back with your report code. You then read the answer and can respond.
Na het versturen ziet u de code één keer: After sending, you see the code once. It is the only way to come back. We cannot send it again.
Wat u van ons mag verwachten: What you can expect from us
Binnen 7 dagen: bevestiging dat wij uw m: Within 7 days: confirmation that we have your report.
Binnen 3 maanden: wat wij met uw melding: Within 3 months: what we did with your report.
Deze pagina bewaart niets waaraan u te h: This page stores nothing that can identify you: no cookies, no IP address.
